create_default_config: create a default ConfigDict with all VMC calculation parameters for molecular quantum Monte Carlo simulations
resolve_config_references: resolve FieldReference values in a ConfigDict and call set_molecule if it is a callable
check_system_type_value: check if a given value matches any SystemType enum member using the has_value class method
configure_optimization_hyperparameters: configure optimizer settings including learning rate, KFAC, and ADAM hyperparameters in the default config
configure_network_architecture: configure FermiNet or PsiFormer network architecture parameters including hidden dims, determinants, and Jastrow factors
